verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Galileo captures sessions, traces, and spans, and can alert on a Cost metric. Neither of those is attributing cost or usage to users, sessions, or features through custom metadata. No evidence documents custom metadata tagging or per-user or per-feature cost breakdowns, so the related observability and alerting features count only as adjacent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata
